Scoring_point_3_Problem_1.answer: Date mismatch between reimbursement claim and receipt: The reimbursement application form (Reimbursement_Form_XINLONG_WANG.xlsx) claims the travel date as October 29, 2024, while the submitted train ticket (train_ticket_05.jpg) clearly shows the travel date as October 28, 2024. According to the 'Policy for Reimbursement of Travel Expenses – Acad.docx', receipts must accurately reflect the actual travel date, and the application must match the receipt. The discrepancy of one day renders the claim invalid.
